scores.reasoning: Valkyr has a strong damage output with her Hysteria ability and can heal herself while doing so. The Paralysis ability further enhances her damage potential by increasing enemy vulnerability to melee attacks.

data.summary: Valkyr is a melee-focused Warframe with strong damage output through her Hysteria ability and limited survivability through her Rage meter. She provides some support to allies but has no stealth capabilities. The combination of abilities can create some complexity in execution, making Valkyr a versatile but not particularly complex Warframe.
